item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Timer Removed.

The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 72 hours if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team.

+ show block
– hide block

I propose adding a crosslink before the testlog of what happened when they tried testing this with anomalous LPs. I hesitate to add this as an actual test because I feel it would ruin the pacing of the existing test logs.

When exposed to SCPs such as SCP-043 and SCP-1668 were initially believed to have no results. However, analysis of audio taken during testing has shown the presence of at least two distinct breathing patterns being broadcast from SCP-373 when either object was being used with it. Further testing is currently under consideration.

item.title: Suggestions
item.content:encoded:
for possible edits:

The first note about "we may be creating these things" seems to be incorrect. Addendum 373-4 seems to indicate that a specific LP does not hold a specific personality… in fact, that the personality is 373 itself, screwing with people.

So that note might need an edit/lineout. Also, since this thing seems to provoke people to use it if it DOESN'T get used, doesn't that kind of take it OUT of "Safe"-class?

Suggest an upgrade to Euclid, until it's better understood.
